values.description:
A list of values [H1, H2, ... ] that defines the set of valid values for a hyperparameter. In most cases, these
values will be of the same type, typically an int, double, or string. However, these {@link #values} accept
elements of Type AnyType to support all types of hyperparameters. Also, this enables the specification of
heterogenous values in cases where valid values of a hyperparameter can take on different types.

title:
This type defines a categorical parameter space, where the valid values for a hyperparameter span a finite set of
points.
Usage Examples:
Setting fields as {values: ['gini', 'noisy', 'entropy']} would sample elements from values provided.
An example of defining a {@link Hp.ParamSpace.Categorical}:
```py
categorical_space = c3.Hp.ParamSpace.Categorical.fromValues(values=['gini', 'noisy', 'entropy'])
```
name: Hp.ParamSpace.Categorical
